resources.string: K.T.O Kids AccessibilityService API prominent disclosure covers: Other actions; Web browsing history; Emails; Precise location; Crash logs; SMS or MMS messages; Name; Email address; Personal identifiers; Address; Phone number; Other user-generated content. Used for parental control and child safety with parent consent. Precise location and Crash logs are not collected via AccessibilityService API. Full in-app disclosure is shown before enabling this service.
